title: Tackling Social Bias against the Poor: A Dataset and Taxonomy on Aporophobia

bias_targets.methodology: Creation of a novel dataset (DRAX) by manually annotating tweets for aporophobia (bias against the poor), developing a detailed taxonomy of aporophobic attitudes/actions, and training/evaluating various language models (BERT variants, Llama, Mixtral, and GPT models) on a three-class classification task (Direct Aporophobia, Reporting Aporophobia, None).
